about.paragraph1: Gimbal Picture Creation began in a spare room with one camera, one gimbal, and a stubborn belief that wedding films didn't have to look staged. A decade later, we're a full studio of cinematographers, photographers, editors and drone pilots — but the belief hasn't changed.
about.paragraph2: We don't direct your wedding. We disappear into it — reading the room, chasing the light, and catching the moments that happen when nobody's posing. What comes back is a film and a gallery you'll actually want to watch again, not just store.
about.quote: We didn't want a photographer at our wedding. We wanted someone invisible who'd hand us back the truth of the day. That's exactly what we got.

process.title: Book
process.desc: Reserve your date with a conversation, not a sales pitch. We learn your story, your families and your vision before anything else.

process.title: Plan
process.desc: Timelines, shot lists, locations and drone permissions — mapped weeks in advance so the day itself stays unhurried.

process.title: Shoot
process.desc: Lead artists, minimal gear footprint, maximum presence. We move through the day quietly, so you never have to perform for the camera.

process.title: Edit
process.desc: Every frame colour-graded by hand. Every cut scored to music that matches your story, not a template.

process.title: Deliver
process.desc: A private online gallery, a hand-bound heirloom album, and a film you'll watch again on every anniversary.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: Most couples reserve their date 6–12 months out, especially for peak wedding season (October–February) and destination weddings. We take a limited number of weddings each season to keep our attention fully on you.

faqs.question: Do you travel for destination weddings?
faqs.answer: Always. We've filmed weddings across Udaipur, Goa, Jaipur, Bali, Dubai and beyond. Travel, accommodation and logistics are built into a transparent destination package — no surprise costs.

faqs.question: What's included in a wedding film package?
faqs.answer: Every package includes a cinematic highlight film, full-length ceremony coverage, a same-day teaser, and licensed music scoring. Drone coverage, extended editing and albums are available as add-ons.

faqs.question: How long until we receive our photos and films?
faqs.answer: Your teaser arrives within 72 hours. The full photo gallery is delivered in 3–4 weeks, and your final cinematic film in 6–8 weeks, depending on the season.

faqs.question: Do you handle drone coverage and permissions?
faqs.answer: Yes — our certified pilots manage all local permissions and no-fly zone checks so you don't have to think about the paperwork, only the shot.

faqs.question: Can we customise our album design?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every album is designed by hand with your input on layout, cover material and paper finish — from matte lay-flat pages to leather-bound heirloom editions.
